query:
SELECT requestNumber, status, urgencyLevel, orcamentoFeitoUrgente
FROM purchaseRequests
WHERE urgencyLevel IN ('urgente', 'emergencial')
  AND status NOT IN ('concluida', 'cancelada')
ORDER BY id DESC
LIMIT 10;
